data_sources.name: vibr_monitor_YYYY_MMDD.csv
data_sources.description: Stores data about the sensors' measurements, including the anomaly values[cite: 209]. Updated weekly[cite: 210].

data_sources.name: components.csv
data_sources.description: Contains contextual information about components (sensors or motor)[cite: 211].

data_sources.name: variables.csv
data_sources.description: Contains contextual information about the variables measured by the sensors, in particular their threshold, important to detect anomalies[cite: 212, 213]. The mapping between sensors and variables is implicit here[cite: 227].

data_sources.name: mat_types.csv
data_sources.description: Contains contextual information about the materials cut by the sensorized machine[cite: 213, 214].

data_sources.name: tool_description.csv
data_sources.description: Contains contextual information about the tools used to cut the materials[cite: 214].
